item.title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
item.description:
Morning, MAC Fellas. It’s Saturday, October third, and we have a weekend of movement. Ethiopian Airlines is dropping five billion dollars on cargo fleets while building out Bishoftu. That is a massive capacity shift for the African network. It could reshape regional competition. Meanwhile, Flydubai launched dedicated freighter routes using three B737-800s. They are targeting ecommerce demand that belly capacity just cannot handle anymore. Worth watching if that squeezes regional narrowbody rates this quarter. Finally, August cargo traffic finished the summer with global growth. Global demand rose by 4.4 percent. The market is definitely holding steady. Stay sharp. See you Monday.
